verifications.claim: BravesVision is the Atlanta Braves' new, team-owned multimedia platform for the 2026 season.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "a multimedia platform owned and operated by the organization that will become the official local television home of the Braves beginning with the 2026 baseball season." (R1); "BravesVision is your new home for Atlanta Braves baseball for the 2026 season!" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Directly states it is team-owned multimedia platform launching for 2026.

verifications.claim: BravesVision delivers over 140 games.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "BravesVision will produce more than 140 games" (R1, R2); "140+ games" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Exact match on number of games produced/delivered.

verifications.claim: BravesVision delivers exclusive pre/post-game shows.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "extensive pre-game and post-game programming" (R1, R2); "pre-game show “Braves On Deck” and extensive postgame analysis" (R3); "pre- and post-game shows" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Supports pre/post-game shows extensively, but 'exclusive' not explicitly stated.
